title: Guest Chat Send receives a trusted click but leaves the draft unsent
surface: Shared @ai-matrx/chat composer in the extension side panel
organization_context: No account token, profile, or organization
preconditions: Exact 0.2.522 Store candidate from release run 39056398246 loaded unpacked under its Store identity on the guarded hosted B runner.
Fresh guest Chat and the page-specific controlled fixture are visible; the 139-character opening question is in the composer and Send is enabled.
reproduction: Run the native guest Chat acceptance with a fresh owned browser profile, open Chat, and enter the page-grounded opening question.
Click the enabled Send message button with the browser input driver. Capture content-free input and click boundaries and CDP request counters.
Observe a trusted click at capture and bubble on the same connected button, followed by the unchanged composer and no chat request or run.
expected: A trusted click on enabled Send submits the opening guest message, emits a real chat POST, and produces a terminal assistant answer grounded in the active page.
actual: In B run 39059598056 the click was trusted, captured, and bubbled while the button stayed connected, but the 139-character draft remained; user messages, chat POSTs, runs, replies, and visible errors all stayed at zero. Earlier exact-artifact B run 39057768241 showed the same unsent draft and zero POST, before the finer click-boundary instrumentation. The Values sheet observer repair passed in 39059598056. Server SHA changed during the native run, so the run also cannot confer release acceptance, independently of the no-send symptom.
reproducibility: Two exact-0.2.522 hosted B runs retained the opening draft with zero POST. The later run proves one trusted capture-and-bubble click on the connected enabled Send button; an independently reviewed harness fixture verified that instrumentation before the run.
severity: S1: guest Chat opening message cannot be sent in the tested Store candidate
priority: P0: diagnose and repair before guest Chat acceptance or Store submission
cause: Source forcing test confirms the extension host omits its guest fingerprint from the shared chat identity. The default token identity reports no fingerprint, so the real package organization gate treats the guest as requiring an organization and refuses before transport. Native run 39060951194 independently rules out DOM-to-React-to-Redux draft loss for both input methods; the repaired native send remains unverified.
sibling_census: The extension Chat tab mounts @ai-matrx/chat ChatNewClient for the guest opening turn and ChatConversationRoom for existing conversations. The same package composer is used for signed-in/member Chat; member behavior on this exact artifact has not been independently tested. Pilot uses a separate extension composer and is not evidence for this defect.
acceptance_criteria: Locate the earliest silent boundary after the trusted bubbling click and establish a deterministic forcing regression that fails before the repair and passes after it.
Repair in the shared @ai-matrx/chat package if the cause is there; publish and adopt latest in the extension in the same session.

Pass focused package and extension checks, an independent source review, and a new guarded native guest Chat run with real POST, terminal opening answer, independent same-conversation follow-up, and post-reload new conversation.
Require stable server SHA and valid package/browser/guest resource finals throughout the acceptance run.
